task: W2-60a (DAEO-cv58) round 3, two items only: (i) for a worktree launch, also check the main checkout's `.claude/settings.local.json` and refuse if it can't be checked; (ii) for an adopted repository, read the role file from `governance/kernel/roles/`
status: DONE. Both items are built, builder tests are green, and the existing acceptance suite shows only the known W2-56 failure. TESTS-READY was absent, so I did not merge the acceptance tests.
work_completed: (i) `record.main_checkout(root, what)` is now a function of its own, split out of `record.folder`. `folder` calls it and its messages are unchanged. `_check_repository_settings` uses it, and for a linked worktree it adds the main checkout's local file to the files it judges, with the same refusals as the tree's own copy. Refusal messages name that file by its full path. If the main checkout can't be found, or its `.git` points to a bare repository, the launch is refused. (ii) `role.py` has a new constant `ADOPTED_ROLES_REL = "governance/kernel/roles"`, used when nothing named `template` exists in the tree. I also updated the design note: Behaviours 1, 6 and 10, a new §3 "Round 3 (review 2, DEC-951)" with rows 9–11, and P-W2-60a-4 is now marked decided.
files_changed: src/gov/launch/launcher.py (+11 −4), src/gov/launch/record.py (+15 −11), src/gov/launch/role.py (+4 −1), tests/unit/launch/test_launch_record.py (+99 −2), tests/unit/launch/test_role.py (+24 −2), docs/changes/W2-60a-CIT-E.md (+38 −4)
evidence: commit `1b32b5b24d40` with trailers Task: DAEO-cv58 · Role: engineer · Implements: DEC-951, DEC-826, DEC-233, DEC-313, DEC-838 · Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5. The code under test is this worktree's own `src/`: `PYTHONPATH=/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-60a/src python3 -c "import gov; print(gov.__file__)"` → `/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-60a/src/gov/__init__.py`. No `pre-commit` file was in the hooks folder (only `*.sample`). `git log --oneline -3`: `1b32b5b24d40` (round 3), `e3bdc0cba595`, `ffc60703e373`.
tests: builder tests (test_role.py and test_launch_record.py) 18 failed before the code change and 76 passed after it. Existing acceptance suite (`-m "not local_only"`): 200 passed, 1 failed, 6 deselected in 132.5 s. The one failure is W2-56's known case, `test_w2_60a_no_compaction_threshold.py::test_a_compaction_threshold_in_the_caller_s_environment_does_not_reach_the_session` (the caller's `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW` reaching the session's process environment). Round 2 also had 200 of 201, so nothing that passed before fails now. Collection over all tests: 17753 of 17755 collected (2 deselected), no collection error. Round 3's acceptance tests were not merged or run, because TESTS-READY does not exist.
discoveries: (1) The real main checkout's `.claude/settings.local.json` has only the top-level keys `env` and `permissions`. Its `permissions` has `allow` and `deny`; its `env` has `GOV_DEV_TIERS`, `GOV_ROLE` and `GOV_TICKET`. None of these is refused, so worktree launches from this repository still pass. I read the key names only, never the values. (2) `git status` lists 11 untracked dotfiles (`.bashrc`, `.mcp.json` and others). They are `/dev/null` devices (1,3) that the sandbox puts over denied names, not files on disk, so there is nothing to remove.
risks: (1) If an acceptance case builds a broken or bare `.git` and expects the record folder's message, it now gets the settings check's refusal first. That check runs at step 4, before the record folder at step 8. None of the existing cases does this. (2) A file named `template` keeps today's template path and is refused there; that is my choice of "exists".
lessons: `gov retrieve` answers STORE_MISSING in this worktree, so read the named files directly. Builder tests for the settings check can build a fake worktree with only a `.git` file and a `commondir` file; no git needs to run.
proposed_decisions: none
unresolved: Merging `w2/W2-60a-tests` and running round 3's acceptance tests, which waits for TESTS-READY (the lead does it).
recommended_next_action: The lead merges `w2/W2-60a-tests` once TESTS-READY exists, runs the W2-60a acceptance suite, then starts review 3.

**Step 0:** (a) the write was refused (`OSError: [Errno 30] Read-only file system`), as required. (b) `git hash-object -w` and `git update-index --refresh` both worked (exit 0). `GOV_ROLE=engineer`, `GOV_TICKET=DAEO-cv58`; the top level is `/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-60a` on branch `w2/W2-60a`.

**Commits:** `1b32b5b24d40`.

**Lines added and removed per file:** as in `files_changed` above.

**What I chose for a main-checkout file that is a link:** it is judged exactly as the tree's own copy is today. If anything exists at the name, the target the link leads to is read and judged. A link that leads nowhere can't be read, so the launch is refused with "cannot be read". I added no new rule for links; none was needed to stay fail-closed. The guard-wiring requirement still applies only to the tree's own `.claude/settings.json`. A launch from the main checkout checks its own local file once, as before.

**Test results as seen:** as in `tests` above: builder tests 76 passed; existing acceptance 200 passed and 1 failed (the W2-56 case named there); collection with no error; the merge and second acceptance run not done because TESTS-READY is absent.

**Packages:** none.

**Read refusals met:** 0.

**gov retrieve:** used once, and it answered STORE_MISSING ("no record graph in the store"). I then read the named files. I did not use the code-graph tool.

**Clean-up:** I made no temporary folders outside pytest's own, which keep only failed runs.
